subject: Kickoff: Finexus console + API staggered onboarding windows
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@finexus.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finexus console + API staggered onboarding windows

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick reply on the intake form — Finexus is ready to move from trial to production for a subset of our merchants. We want a pragmatic onboarding: a console walkthrough for the ops team and a separate API enablement for our engineering squad. The engineering group spans two timezones (PST / CET) so we're trying to avoid a single long session.

Preferred approach: two 90-minute sessions (console first, API deep-dive second), staggered across different days so the engineers can attend the API session at a convenient local time. Ideal windows for us: Oct 6–9 (mornings PST / late afternoons CET). Can your team support split sessions and a short runbook for post-session follow-up?

Also looped procurement (procurement@finexus.com) — they'll need access checklist and any licensing notes for our billing team.

Thanks —
Samira
Head of Integrations, Finexus
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@finexus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, procurement@finexus.com
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finexus console + API staggered onboarding windows

Hi Samira —

This plan works well. We can run two 90-minute sessions on separate days and tailor the API deep-dive to the engineering cadence you described. Proposed schedule options (all times PT):

- Option A: Console walkthrough — Oct 7, 09:00–10:30 PT; API deep-dive — Oct 8, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Console walkthrough — Oct 6, 11:00–12:30 PT; API deep-dive — Oct 9, 11:00–12:30 PT

If you prefer later CET-friendly times, we can shift to 16:00–17:30 PT on those days.

Attachments: I attached a short runbook that outlines objectives, preflight checklist, and requested prep from your side (Finexus_Onboarding_Runbook_v1.pdf). Also included a one-page cheatsheet for the Console UI that your ops team can use after the session (redwood_console_cheatsheet.pdf).

Action items:
- Samira: confirm which option + preferred timezone block (PT morning vs PT late-afternoon).
- Procurement: let us know any legal/license contacts or if you need a separate billing summary for the purchase order.
- Ben: can you lead the API deep-dive and prepare sample curl snippets + service account setup slides?

Jonas will own calendar invites and access provisioning during the sessions (Jonas, please add calendar blocks and include the Drive folder).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Finexus_Onboarding_Runbook_v1.pdf (19KB stub), redwood_console_cheatsheet.pdf (6KB stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@finexus.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finexus console + API staggered onboarding windows

Grace / Samira — quick note: I can lead the API segment. Prefer Option A with the API deep-dive on Oct 8, 09:00–10:30 PT. I'll prepare:

- Example curl + python snippets for token exchange and streaming responses
- Service account creation + IAM scope checklist
- A short troubleshooting runbook for common auth errors

If you want me to pre-stage a small sandbox dataset or example prompts, Samira, tell me which merchant flows to prioritize.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@finexus.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@finexus.com
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finexus console + API staggered onboarding windows

Thanks — Option A (Console Oct 7 / API Oct 8, both 09:00–10:30 PT) looks good for our squads.

Procurement will circulate the PO and a DocuSign for admin access (link incoming). We will prioritize two merchant flows for the API deep-dive: 1) tokenized payout creation and 2) dispute enrichment webhooks. Ben — please focus the samples on those flows.

Jonas — please send calendar invites and the Drive link (we'll add any internal pre-reads there).

Appreciate the runbook — we'll review and flag any gaps.

Best,
Samira
Head of Integrations, Finexus
